stem.text: A perfectly elastic collision occurs between two objects X and Y. The mass of X is $m$ and the mass of Y is $4m$. Object X travels at speed $v$ before the collision and speed $\dfrac{3v}{5}$ in the opposite direction after the collision. Object Y is stationary before the collision.

stem.alt: Before the collision: object X (mass m) moving right with arrow labelled v; object Y (mass 4m) stationary; labelled before.
After the collision: object X (mass m) with arrow labelled 3v/5 pointing left; object Y (mass 4m) with arrow pointing right; labelled after.

stem.text: What is the kinetic energy of Y after the collision?
